chapter: Jazz opinions, Jelly Roll and the Rhythm Club
title: The $2,000 interview check made out to Mr. and Mrs.
summary: JCH raises the check payable to both; it was done so both signatures were needed because he cannot leave the house.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: I told you that you would be getting paid for this interview and I gave you the check for $2,000.
That's what I wanted to ask you.
What are you planning to do with that money? Do you have any ideas as to things that you would like?

I know what I'm going to do with it. I gotta have my teeth fixed and I've gotta get glasses. But what I can't understand is how you had it made out to Mr. and Mrs. I can cash a $5,000 check without my wife's name being on it.
The reason it was made out to -
No offense, just let me say this... She said the other night, I haven't finished reading your letter. I didn't know

how much money it was, because money don't bother me, never did. So she said, I'm going to straighten out this money business. So I didn't know what she was talking about. But when I look at it, I said, well this is nice. See, these got to be fixed and I got to get glasses. Now, you got Mr. and Mrs. Higginbotham. Now what she's going to do, cash it and tell me, I'm going to take this and there's going to be trouble. But there won't be no trouble. I'll tell you why. Just cool, everybody. There ain't going to be no trouble 'cause I got another check coming. I'll say if you want to take part of this, you take it and you won't get nothing in the next one, like that.

The check was made out that way because you told me that you hadn't been out of the house in a year and you couldn't get downstairs, so it was decided that the best way to do it would be to have your name and your wife's name -
You see, that way you would have to sign it, endorse it on the back, and she would have to endorse it on the back before it was cashed.

I understand but I've given her plenty checks, you know, and haven't been out but twice. Just sign it, she cashed the checks. So I looked at Mr. and Mrs. and said, "What? I didn't know she was doing as much as me?" But it doesn't make any difference. It's in the family.
That's why it was made out that way.
